newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian pound average 3.3908/3.3927 to dlr.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian pound average 3.3908/3.3927 to dlr.

text.p: Private-sector Egyptian banks said the dollar ranged from 3.3890 to 3.3920 bid and 3.3900 to 3.3950 offer in the interbank market on Tuesday.
A survey of four actively trading banks gave average rates of 3.3908 pounds bid and 3.3927 offered. The averages compared to 3.3916 pounds bid and 3.3942 offered on Monday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday (1000 GMT) as 3.389622 buy and 3.396390 sell.
